## Definition of Ready

> All boxes must be checked before this issue can enter a sprint.

- [ ] Description is clearly outlined and understood by the team
- [ ] User story defined (`As a [user], I want [goal] so that [reason]`)
- [ ] Dependencies identified, noted below, and resolved (or have a clear resolution path)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are clearly defined and testable
- [ ] Design / UX assets provided or explicitly not required
- [ ] Security implications considered
- [ ] Performance / scalability implications considered

---

## Definition of Done

> All boxes must be checked before this issue can be closed.

- [ ] All Acceptance Criteria met and verified
- [ ] Code reviewed and approved (per branch/PR policy)
- [ ] Automated tests written and passing (unit / integration / E2E as appropriate)
- [ ] No regressions introduced (existing test suite passes)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, API docs, Confluence, etc.)
- [ ] Code is appropriately commented — especially non-obvious logic
- [ ] Suitable error handling and user-facing error messages in place
- [ ] Observability in place (logs, metrics, alerts where applicable)
